resources.string: Other apps can ask DSH to run a task through RUN_TASK (no screen content is attached). Off by default.
%1$s asked DSH to run a task; refused. Turn on Settings → General → Allow other apps to accept.
The app was stopped by the system during this turn. Tap Continue to pick up where it left off.

Android did not allow starting the engine in the background (usually battery optimization was turned back on). Tap the notification to run it.
